label: prop:q-exponential-taylor
title: Taylor series of $\exp_q$ (archimedean)
html:
Let R be a commutative ring of characteristic zero in which all Jackson factorials [n]_q! = \prod_{k=1}^{n} \frac{1 - q^k}{1 - q} are invertible. Over R, the convergent power series

  \exp_q(x) = \sum_{n \ge 0} \frac{x^n}{[n]_q!}

represents the abstract grouplike \exp_q \in G(\mathcal{H}_q).

Archimedean specialisation. What follows sits on the archimedean side of the substrate wall. It invokes real- or complex-analytic constructs—real-valued physical observables, bounds, transcendental constants, or numerical evaluation at q_0. Categorical identities remain valid over an abstract coefficient ring; only their archimedean realisation is strictly specialised here.
